title: Server Actions bilan Zero-JS Form Yuborish
author: Anvar Alimov
content: Next.js App Router dagi Server Actions ('use server') yordamida formani hech qanday client-side fetch API va onSubmit hodisalarisiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri server funksiyasiga ulash mumkin.

title: useFormStatus va useActionState Hooklari
author: Zuhra Karimova
content: useFormStatus forma yuborilish jarayonida 'Yuborilmoqda...' holatini ko'rsatishga, useActionState esa backend validatsiya xatolarini ushlab ekranda ko'rsatishga xizmat qiladi.
